name: Conventions page renders the seeded scan and candidates
description: Loads /conventions directly (no :repoId in the route — the page falls through useActiveRepo() to the seeded acme/payments-api, the only repo in a freshly-seeded DB) and confirms the seeded convention_scans + conventions rows render: the heading names the repo, the sample-file count and '1 of 3 accepted' summary appear, and all three seeded candidates (an accepted model rule, a pending semantic rule, and a pending config rule) are visible with their evidence paths. Read-only seeded data — no scan is started, no candidate is accepted/rejected, no model call. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (see e2e/README.md).
